rules.logic: ABIOC(KOI-007 Unattended MCP Tool Invocation with No User Interaction) AND ABIOC(KOI-007 Sampling-Request Token Consumption Anomaly from MCP Host) on the same agent_hostname and actor_effective_username within a 15-minute window — fuses the covert writeFile deviation and the quota-theft consumption anomaly into a single MCP-sampling-abuse incident anchored to the MCP-server session that drove the createMessage calls.
rules.name: MCP Sampling Abuse — Quota Theft plus Covert Tool Invocation Stitch
